extracted.intended_audience: Users of the PARI/GP library (number theorists, mathematicians, and developers using PARI/GP number-field routines)
extracted.subtask_description: Reference documentation for PARI/GP number-field (nf*) and related functions: purpose, inputs, outputs, flags, examples, caveats and suggested usage patterns for each routine.

rubrics_metrics.name: idealstar / idealstar0 flags and behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: GEN idealstar0(GEN nf, GEN I, long flag) (recommended GEN Idealstar(GEN nf, GEN ideal, long flag)). Flag controls output: include generators (nf_GEN) and/or return a full bid (nf_INIT) or neither; combinations determine whether generators are returned, a full bid is returned, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid using hard-coded numeric flags; use named flags (nf_GEN, nf_INIT) or the higher-level GEN Idealstar for clearer semantics. One combination yields generators but no init, etc. Example note: using generators wastes time if not needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: idealtwoelt
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes a two-element representation of an ideal x in number field nf, returning [a, α] with x = a·ZK + α·ZK. Default chooses a as positive generator of x ∩ Z (or a = 0 for principal ideal).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Two calling variants: idealtwoelt(nf,x) (randomized polynomial time, uses lazy factorization of x ∩ Z) and idealtwoelt(nf,x,a) (requires factoring a, generally much slower). Library syntaxes: GEN idealtwoelt0(GEN nf, GEN x, GEN a = NULL), GEN idealtwoelt(GEN nf, GEN x), GEN idealtwoelt2(GEN nf, GEN x, GEN a). The function handles extended ideals (principal part ignored).

rubrics_metrics.name: idealval
rubrics_metrics.description: Gives the valuation of ideal x at prime ideal pr in number field nf (pr in idealprimedec format).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: long idealval(GEN nf, GEN x, GEN pr).

rubrics_metrics.name: matalgtobasis
rubrics_metrics.description: Applies nfalgtobasis entrywise to a vector or matrix x for number field nf (nf in nfinit format).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN matalgtobasis(GEN nf, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: matbasistoalg
rubrics_metrics.description: Applies nfbasistoalg to each entry of a row/column vector or matrix x for nf in nfinit format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN matbasistoalg(GEN nf, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: modreverse
rubrics_metrics.description: Given z = Mod(A,T) (a polmod) with Q = minpoly(z) of degree deg(T), returns Mod(B,Q) which is a 'reverse polmod' — a root of T.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful to change generating element and convert between representations; fails if minpoly(z) has lower degree than expected (domain error). Library syntax: GEN modreverse(GEN z). Example demonstrates obtaining new defining polynomial and explicit isomorphism; error example shows deg(minpoly(z)) < expected.

rubrics_metrics.name: newtonpoly
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns vector of slopes of Newton polygon of polynomial x with respect to prime p in decreasing order; vector length equals degree(x).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Vertical slopes (when constant coefficient is zero) are denoted by LONG_MAX (machine-dependent). See Section 3.2.55 for LONG_MAX. Library syntax: GEN newtonpoly(GEN x, GEN p).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfalgtobasis (algtobasis)
rubrics_metrics.description: Transforms an algebraic number x in number field nf to column vector coordinates on the integral basis nf.zk (inverse of nfbasistoalg).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples show conversion of elements and Mod(...) form. Library syntax: GEN algtobasis(GEN nf, GEN x) (named nfalgtobasis in text).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfbasis
rubrics_metrics.description: Given irreducible integral polynomial T(X), returns an integral basis (Z-basis of maximal order) of the number field Q[X]/(T), basis elements as elements of Q[X]/(T).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Uses a modified Round 4 algorithm (Ford/Pauli/Roblot). Can accept [T, listP] to compute basis maximal at primes in listP; listP may be vector of primes, factorization matrix, or integer B (primes ≤ B). Composite, pairwise-coprime integers allowed in listP; including a composite C with C^2 | disc(T) can help factorization or test maximality but may yield non-maximal order otherwise. Examples and workflow for using nfinit + nfcertify to obtain/verify maximal order are provided. Library syntax: nfbasis(GEN T, GEN *d, GEN listP = NULL); returns basis and sets *d to order discriminant.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfbasistoalg (basistoalg)
rubrics_metrics.description: Transforms algebraic number x (in nf) into t_POLMOD form (inverse of nfalgtobasis).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples provided. Library syntax: GEN basistoalg(GEN nf, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfcertify
rubrics_metrics.description: Checks whether the integer basis in nf (output of nfinit) is known unconditionally (i.e., whether nf.zk and nf.disc are correct).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns vector of composite integers: empty vector => nf.zk and nf.disc are correct; otherwise, the returned integers must be completely factored, added with addprime, and nfdisc(nf.pol) compared to nf.disc to certify. Library syntax: GEN nfcertify(GEN nf).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfdetint
rubrics_metrics.description: Given a pseudo-matrix x, computes a non-zero ideal contained in (a multiple of) the determinant of x.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Particularly useful with nfhnfmod to avoid coefficient explosion. Library syntax: GEN nfdetint(GEN nf, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfdisc
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the (field) discriminant of the number field defined by integral irreducible polynomial T (Round 4 algorithm).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Argument T may be [T, listP] (like nfbasis) to compute discriminant of an order maximal at listP primes; padic discriminant extraction example given. Library syntax: nfdisc(GEN T) (listP = NULL). Also mentions related nfbasis(GEN T, GEN *d, GEN listP = NULL).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltadd (nfadd)
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes sum x + y of two elements x and y in number field nf.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN nfadd(GEN nf, GEN x, GEN y).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltdiv (nfdiv)
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes quotient x / y of two elements in number field nf.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN nfdiv(GEN nf, GEN x, GEN y).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltdiveuc (nfdiveuc)
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes an algebraic integer q such that components of x - qy are reasonably small; functionally identical to round(nfdiv(nf,x,y)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN nfdiveuc(GEN nf, GEN x, GEN y).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltdivmodpr
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes quotient x/y modulo prime ideal pr in modpr format (nfmodprinit) with coefficients in nf.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN nfdivmodpr(GEN nf, GEN x, GEN y, GEN pr). Normally useless in 'library mode' — recommended to project inputs to residue field via nf to Fq and work there for efficiency.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltdivrem (nfdivrem)
rubrics_metrics.description: Gives [q, r] such that x = qy + r with q an algebraic integer and r has reasonably small components.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN nfdivrem(GEN nf, GEN x, GEN y).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltmod (nfmod)
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes an element r = x − qy with q algebraic integer and r small; functionally x − nfmul(nf, round(nfdiv(nf,x,y)), y).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN nfmod(GEN nf, GEN x, GEN y).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltmul (nfmul)
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes product x * y of two elements in number field nf.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN nfmul(GEN nf, GEN x, GEN y).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltmulmodpr (nfmulmodpr)
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes product x*y modulo prime ideal pr in modpr format (nfmodprinit).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN nfmulmodpr(GEN nf, GEN x, GEN y, GEN pr). Normally useless in library mode; project to residue field instead.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltnorm (nfnorm)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the absolute norm of element x in number field nf.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN nfnorm(GEN nf, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltpow (nfpow) and related
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes x^k for integer k (positive or negative) in number field nf. nfinv corresponds to k = −1 and nfsqr to k = 2.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN nfpow(GEN nf, GEN x, GEN k). Also available: GEN nfinv(GEN nf, GEN x) and GEN nfsqr(GEN nf, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltpowmodpr
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes x^k modulo prime ideal pr (modpr format).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN nfpowmodpr(GEN nf, GEN x, GEN k, GEN pr). Normally unnecessary in library mode; prefer residue field methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltreduce (nfreduce)
rubrics_metrics.description: Given ideal id in Hermite normal form and element a in nf, finds r in nf such that a − r ∈ id and r is small.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN nfreduce(GEN nf, GEN a, GEN id).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltreducemodpr
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute canonical representative of class of x modulo prime ideal pr (modpr format).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN nfreducemodpr(GEN nf, GEN x, GEN pr). Normally unnecessary in library mode; project to residue field.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfelttrace (nftrace)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns the absolute trace of element x in number field nf.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN nftrace(GEN nf, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfeltval (nfval) / idealval equivalence
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes valuation at prime ideal pr of element x in nf; same result obtainable via idealval(nf,x,pr) since x is converted to a principal ideal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: long nfval(GEN nf, GEN x, GEN pr).

rubrics_metrics.name: nffactor
rubrics_metrics.description: Factorization of univariate polynomial T over number field nf (nf from nfinit); factors sorted by increasing degree.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coefficients of T may be scalar, polmod, polynomial or column vector. Main variable of nf must be lower priority than that of T except when nf.pol occurs explicitly as modulus; in that case main variable must match. Inputting a defining polynomial for nf is possible but less efficient; when nf constructed with partial discriminant factorization, pass nf.pol to nffactor to avoid missed factors. Library syntax: GEN nffactor(GEN nf, GEN T).

rubrics_metrics.name: nffactorback
rubrics_metrics.description: Given a factorization f (and optional exponents e), returns the nf element corresponding to that factorization (integer 1 corresponds to empty factorization).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If e present, e and f must be same length and integral; if f vector and no e, e assumed vector of 1s. f can be a regular factorization matrix. Example given; library syntax: GEN nffactorback(GEN nf, GEN f, GEN e = NULL).

rubrics_metrics.name: nffactormod
rubrics_metrics.description: Factors univariate polynomial Q modulo prime ideal pr in number field nf; coefficients may be in nf (including polmod). Coefficients of polynomial factors are lifted to elements of nf.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Main variable priority constraints as in nffactor. Prime ideal pr may be in idealprimedec or preferred nfmodprinit format; using nfmodprinit can be ≈10% faster due to precomputation. Library syntax: GEN nffactormod(GEN nf, GEN Q, GEN pr).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfgaloisapply
rubrics_metrics.description: Applies a Galois automorphism aut (expressed by image of field generator) to object x in nf (x can be element or ideal — vector/matrix forbidden).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Automorphism aut may be given as polynomial image or as column vector (image in basistoalg form) — latter is faster for repeated calls. Beware: ideal representations may differ after automorphism application even when ideals are equal; equality tests may fail due to representation differences. Example shows performance difference for repeated calls. Library syntax: GEN galoisapply(GEN nf, GEN aut, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfgaloisconj (galoisconj)
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes conjugates of a root of nf[1] (polynomial) expressed as polynomials in the root; for nf possibly not Galois some conjugates may lie in the field. Various flags change algorithm (0 default, 1 uses nfroots, 2 obsolete, 4 uses galoisinit for fast Galois fields).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Default (flag=0) combines flags 4 and 1 and is complete. Flag=1 is slower but polynomial-time guaranteed. Flag=2 obsolete and unreliable. Flag=4 fast but applies only to (most) Galois fields and may return only identity if group not weakly super-solvable. If present, d is assumed multiple of common denominator. Can compute K-automorphisms via rnfgaloisconj trick. Library syntax: GEN galoisconj0(GEN nf, long flag, GEN d = NULL, long prec); recommended: GEN galoisconj(GEN nf, GEN d) (flag=0).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfhilbert
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute quadratic Hilbert symbol (a,b) in nf (global) or local symbol modulo prime ideal pr; returns 1 if x^2 − a y^2 − b z^2 has nontrivial solution in nf, −1 otherwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: long nfhilbert0(GEN nf, GEN a, GEN b, GEN pr = NULL). Also available long nfhilbert(GEN bnf,GEN a,GEN b) for global symbol.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfhnf
rubrics_metrics.description: Given pseudo-matrix (A,I), finds pseudo-basis in Hermite normal form of module generated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN nfhnf(GEN nf, GEN x). Also available: GEN rnfsimplifybasis(GEN bnf, GEN x) to simplify pseudo-basis; ideals in I are integral, primitive and either trivial or non-principal.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfhnfmod
rubrics_metrics.description: Given pseudo-matrix (A,I) and an ideal detx (integral multiple of determinant), finds pseudo-basis in Hermite normal form while avoiding coefficient explosion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: detx can be computed via nfdetint; library syntax: GEN nfhnfmod(GEN nf, GEN x, GEN detx).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfinit
rubrics_metrics.description: Initializes number field structure (nf) from non-constant integral polynomial pol (preferably monic, irreducible). Result is a row vector with components: pol, signature [r1,r2], discriminant, index, matrices (M,G,roundG,T,MD,TI,MDI), roots, integral basis nf.zk, change-of-basis matrix, multiplication table, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If polynomial non-monic, nfinit makes it monic and may apply polredbest when flag set. Special input formats allowed: [pol, B] where B can be integer basis or listP to compute order maximal at given primes; useful for huge discriminants. Flags: 2 => use polredbest and return simplified polynomial; 3 => polredbest and also return change-of-variable Mod(a,P). Use nfinitall with named flags (nf_RED, nf_ORIG, nf_ROUND2 (deprecated), nf_PARTIALFACT (deprecated)). Many examples show accessing nf.pol, nf.disc, nf.index, nf.zk, nf.sign and using nfcertify to confirm unconditional correctness. Library syntaxes: GEN nfinit0(GEN pol, long flag, long prec), GEN nfinit(GEN x, long prec) (flag=0), GEN nfinitred(GEN x, long prec) (flag=2), GEN nfinitred2(GEN x, long prec) (flag=3).

rubrics_metrics.name: isideal (nﬁsideal)
rubrics_metrics.description: Tests whether x is an ideal in number field nf, returning 1 if yes, 0 otherwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: long isideal(GEN nf, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfisincl
rubrics_metrics.description: Tests whether field defined by polynomial x is conjugate to a subfield of field defined by y (both in Q[X]); returns 0 or vector of embeddings (polynomials a with y | x ◦ a).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If y is a number field (nf), a faster algorithm is used (nffactor over y). Previous versions missed embeddings; current version guaranteed to return all embeddings. Library syntax: GEN nfisincl(GEN x, GEN y).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfisisom
rubrics_metrics.description: Tests for isomorphism between fields defined by x and y (like nfisincl but checking isomorphism).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If either x or y is a number field, faster algorithm used. Library syntax: GEN nfisisom(GEN x, GEN y).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfkermodpr
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes kernel of matrix a over ZK/pr where pr is in modpr format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN nfkermodpr(GEN nf, GEN x, GEN pr). Normally unnecessary in library mode; project to residue field via nfM to FqM instead.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfmodprinit
rubrics_metrics.description: Transforms prime ideal pr into modpr format necessary for modular operations modulo pr in nf.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN nfmodprinit(GEN nf, GEN pr). Use this format to speed modular computations (factoring/polynomial mod operations).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfnewprec
rubrics_metrics.description: Transforms nf to use current (usually larger) precision; works for nf and bnf (bnf updated to current precision) but may be slow (many principal ideal generators recomputed).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Library syntax: GEN nfnewprec(GEN nf, long prec). See also GEN bnfnewprec and GEN bnrnewprec for related objects.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfroots
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute roots of polynomial x in number field nf (nf from nfinit) without multiplicity (or in Q if nf omitted). Coefficients of x may be in number field format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Main variable of nf must be of lower priority than that of x; if number-field coefficients occur explicitly as polmods, their variable must match main variable of x. Inputting a defining polynomial for nf is possible but less efficient; be careful with unsafe nf (partial discriminant factorizations) and addprimes (may miss roots). Safer to input nf.pol if nf is unsafe. Library syntax: GEN nfroots(GEN nf = NULL, GEN x); also GEN nfrootsQ(GEN x) for nf = NULL.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfrootsof1 (rootsof1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns [w, z] where w is number of roots of unity in nf and z is a primitive w-th root of unity (in algebraic form).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Algorithm guesses w as gcd of #k(v)^* for unramified v above odd primes, then computes roots of w-th cyclotomic polynomial; polynomial-time in field degree and bitsize of multiplication table. Fields up to degree ~100 should run under a minute. Library syntax: GEN rootsof1(GEN nf). Alternative: GEN rootsof1_kannan(GEN nf) using Kannan's method (may be faster when roots of 1 present but can be much slower).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfsnf
rubrics_metrics.description: Given ZK-module x (integral pseudo-matrix [A,I,J]), returns ideal list d1,...,dn which is Smith normal form: x ≅ ZK/d1 ⊕ ... ⊕ ZK/dn with di | d_{i-1}.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inputs: integral pseudo-matrix 3-component row vector [A,I,J] where integrality condition ai,j ∈ b_i a_j^{-1} must hold; if not, di may not be integral. Every finitely generated torsion module can be represented in this input form. See Section 3.6.4.1 for definitions. Library syntax: GEN nfsnf(GEN nf, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: nfsolvemodpr
rubrics_metrics.description: Solves a · x = b over residue field of prime ideal P (modpr format) where a is invertible; lifts solution coefficients to nf elements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example provided. Library syntax: GEN nfsolvemodpr(GEN nf, GEN a, GEN b, GEN P). Normally unnecessary in library mode; project to residue field via nfM to FqM instead.

rubrics_metrics.name: nfsubfields
rubrics_metrics.description: Finds all subfields of degree d of number field defined by monic integral polynomial pol (or all subfields if d omitted); returns vector of [g,h] pairs where g is absolute equation and h expresses root of g in terms of root x of pol.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Uses Klüners algorithm in general and Allombert's galoissubfields when nf is Galois (weakly supersolvable group). Library syntax: GEN nfsubfields(GEN pol, long d).

rubrics_metrics.name: polcompositum
rubrics_metrics.description: Given squarefree polynomials P,Q in Z[X] in same variable, outputs simple factors of etale Q-algebra Q(X,Y)/(P(X),Q(Y)), returning polynomials R (defining Q[X]/(R)) sorted by increasing degree; errors if inputs not squarefree.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: More efficient to reduce P,Q to irreducible factors before calling. If P irreducible and deg(P) ≤ deg(Q), faster approach: nf = nfinit(P); L = nffactor(nf, Q)[,1]; vector(..., rnfequation(nf, L[i])). If flag=1, outputs vector of [R,a,b,k] giving compositums and relations. Compositum polynomials can be complicated; recommended to reduce polredbest afterwards. Library syntaxes: GEN polcompositum0(GEN P, GEN Q, long flag); also GEN compositum(GEN P, GEN Q) (flag=0) and GEN compositum2(GEN P, GEN Q) (flag=1).

rubrics_metrics.name: polgalois
rubrics_metrics.description: Computes Galois group of irreducible non-constant polynomial T ∈ Q[X] (action on d distinct roots up to conjugacy). Current implementation for degree d ≤ 7 (and 8–11 if galdata installed).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Output is [n, s, k, name]: n = cardinality, s = signature (1 if subgroup of A_d, -1 otherwise), name = group name from GAP transitive groups library; k is encoding varying by degree (historical ad hoc for d ≤ 7). Library syntax and degree limitations noted; see documentation for group coding details.
